title: Jotform website
lede: Jotform’s home page: two flat figures at laptops sit inside pastel blob shapes on either side of a sign-up card.
summary: Flat figures in blue and yellow blobs around a centred sign-up card, with a heavy navy heading. Live site.

evidence.note: Captured with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 and inspected. No cookie box covers the page. The screenshot shows the first viewport; the measurement covers up to four screens.

styles.note: Borderline: flat figures with laptops sit in pastel blobs on a white page, but their proportions are ordinary and their skin is natural, so the gangly, non-natural figure is missing. A late, softened form of the style on a live site.

observed: A small orange overline, “EASIEST ONLINE FORM BUILDER”, sits above the heavy navy heading “Powerful forms get it done.”
In the centre, a white card with a thin border holds three full-width buttons: blue for Google, black for Apple, and orange for email.
On the left, a woman in a green top with a pink headset types on a laptop inside a bright blue blob; an orange cat sleeps on top of the blob.
On the right, a woman with brown skin and a navy bob works at a grey laptop in front of a yellow blob, with a green check mark badge.
Figures have faces with eyes and mouths and roughly natural proportions; fills are flat with small darker shadow shapes.
interpretation: The page keeps the style’s scene grammar (a figure, a device, a pastel blob, white space) after the gangly proportions went out of fashion. The measurement finds a median radius of 7 px and shadows on 9% of boxes.
borrow: Set each spot figure inside one saturated blob shape, and let one small object (a cat, a check mark) break the blob’s outline.

images.alt: Jotform home page: a heavy navy heading above a sign-up card with Google, Apple, and email buttons, flanked by two flat figures working at laptops inside blue and yellow blob shapes.
images.caption: First viewport of [Jotform](https://www.jotform.com/).
